_about: Settings for the self-improvement loop (scripts/improver.py). It changes ONE variable at a time, tests it, measures it against the goal, and keeps it as the new baseline only if it is better.

goal._about: score = profit % after fees - drawdown_weight x worst drop %. Higher is better. A change must beat the baseline by min_improvement on the search window, and by more than min_improvement_confirm on the confirm window.

windows._about: Each change is first tested on the SEARCH window (older data). If it wins there, it must ALSO win on the CONFIRM window (the most recent months), which played no part in picking it. Both windows move forward every week.

variables._about: Dotted config path -> the values it may take. Each experiment moves exactly one of these one step up or down from the current baseline.
